title: Lemon tart
hookLine: Viral American & European lemon tart crafted for mobile Cook Mode & 1-tap Story sharing.

items.name: All-butter pastry crust (or crisp biscuit topping)
Egg wash or heavy cream glaze

steps.title: Toss Filling & Line Baking Dish
steps.instructionTemplate: Toss {eu94_main} with {eu94_sug}. Fit {eu94_crust} into your dish and dot with {eu94_but}. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {eu94_crust} and {eu94_but} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Cornstarch locks in juices so slices cut cleanly instead of turning watery.

steps.title: Bake Until Jammy & Deep Golden
steps.instructionTemplate: Brush top with {eu94_egg} and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes until golden brown and bubbling. Let Lemon tart cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 8 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Rest 20 minutes before slicing so the filling thickens to glossy jam consistency.
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

steps.title: Bake Lemon tart & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 35 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Lemon tart to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 8 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
